rule: No B2 claim record may be created until this registry is versioned with a frozen allowlist and B2-1-SOURCE-UNIVERSE-FROZEN is closed.
independence_rule: Syndicated or copied material shares one independence_cluster and counts once regardless of publisher count.
archive_rule: Each accepted publication must retain a content hash and, where feasible, an archive locator or raw-byte repository path.
prohibited_sources: prediction markets, betting odds and third-party seat forecasts
private or leaked material without public verifiability
LLM-generated summaries used as source evidence

closure_requirements.minimum_T1_party_coverage_rule: Every in-scope party receives an explicit official-source entry or an explicit documented absence.
